author: ZoomOG
body:
Hey Its me ItsBatmanYT

I was banned for Anti-Knockback :( I hadnt realised i was using it until then, I had my hacks on because i was trolling my friend on his lan world! I had forgot i had my client running (Metro 5.2) I only realised once i had been banned i had it running. It is horrible being banned on this server for 3 reasons
1. It was my favourite server ever! (Love the walls!)
2. I was about to apply for staff :(
3. I was just getting back into the server!

So can you guys please unban me it would mean the world to me! Thanks!

ItsBatmanYT

For further discussion msg me on skype at jtdiamondminer!
Or on youtube www.youtube.com/c/GamingTurtle179!

I do not use hacks frequently! That was the second time i have ever hacked before!

replies.body:
Hello,
Unfortunately we do not take these cases lightly. We will not accept your excuse for "accidently" leaving your illegal modifications on. It was your mistake - so you must pay the price. 
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ez2xntKcKZo&feature=youtu.be
Thanks.
